method: Compared with the pdftotext text layer (raw and -layout modes) of the official SQP and MS PDFs from .sources-cache/p3/cbse-sqp-2025-26-xii-physics/ (SHA-256 checked against source.sha256).

source.notes: SQP SHA-256 matches source.sha256 exactly. Both PDFs are on cbseacademic.nic.in (the board's own domain). Title 'PHYSICS - Code No. 042', 'SAMPLE QUESTION PAPER', 'CLASS - XII (2025-26)', Time Allowed 3 hours, Maximum Marks 70 all match the pack's stored metadata. The MS PDF has no separate stored hash field in the pack; it was located alongside the SQP in the same cache folder and its content was cross-checked question by question.

questions.notes: Chapter check: the official reasoning turns on V=q/C and the capacitance of an isolated sphere (C=4pi*eps0*r), which is Electrostatic Potential and Capacitance content, not Electric Charges and Fields.
Rebuilt fractions 4rhoND/d^2 etc. confirmed against MS derivation R=4rhoND/d^2.

questions.reason: Phasor diagram on page 2 is needed to see that current leads voltage and identify the device as a capacitor; not reproduced in the pack.
Answer options (A)-(D) are ray-diagram images on pages 2-3, not reproduced as text; question is not answerable from the pack alone.
questions.notes: Question stem and officialAnswer text ('Total Internal reflection') match the MS.

questions.reason: Source intensity-distance graph and answer options (A)-(D), which are graph images, are not reproduced as text; question is not answerable from the pack alone.
questions.notes: officialAnswer text matches MS ('Slit width increases hence amplitude will increase...').

questions.reason: Energy-level diagram defining transitions I-VI (page 4) not reproduced; can't verify why transition IV is the minimum-energy (maximum-wavelength) emission without it.
questions.notes: Rebuilt subscripts DeltaE_I > DeltaE_II > DeltaE_IV match the MS ordering exactly.

questions.reason: Figure/map locating points P and Q (e.g. near equator vs pole) not reproduced; needed to justify the 'opposite directions' answer.

questions.notes: Reason (R) mentions 'blue' while Assertion is about 'violet'; that mismatch is printed in the source itself and correctly reproduced verbatim.

questions.reason: Vector arrow over E is dropped from the question text ('electric field (E)' instead of vector-E); label-only loss with no effect on the physics, but notation is not intact per the rubric.
questions.notes: officialAnswer (E = 153 sin(...) N/C) matches the MS exactly.

questions.reason: V-I graph on page 6 not reproduced; the two graph points (0,6) and (12,0) used to compute emf and internal resistance are not stated anywhere in the question text.
questions.notes: officialAnswer numbers (emf 6V, r=0.5 ohm) match the MS.
Answer is a field-line diagram the student draws from memory; MS also has no text answer for this part, only mark placeholders.
Rebuilt '1/sqrt(V)' and answer formulas confirmed against MS (lambda=h/sqrt(2mqV), slope=h/sqrt(2mq)).
MS gives 1 mark each for (I)(A), (I)(B), (II); pack correctly prints only the printed total (3).

questions.reason: Xe is given as mass number 133 in the question and repeated in the officialAnswer's nuclear equation, but mass-number balance (239+1 = A_Xe+103+3) and the MS's own nuclear-equation line both give 134. Likely a misread of the stacked super/subscript during extraction.
questions.notes: The numeric energy calculation itself (Q = 0.2032 amu x 931.5 MeV = 189.2808 MeV) matches the MS exactly and uses the correct mass value (133.905040u, which is the real Xe-134 mass); only the isotope label '133' is wrong.
Part (I) numeric answer (v0=8.3cm, M=-87.7) matches MS exactly; part (II) is a ray diagram the student draws, with no text answer in either the pack or the MS.
Standard Huygens-principle derivation; student draws own wavefront diagram, the MS's specific point labels (A-G) are not essential to answering.
All coordinates/vectors are given numerically in the text; no external figure needed.

MS's final derivation line ('Or, εmax = 2Mv') is garbled in the source PDF itself; no clean final numeric value is available in the scheme. All earlier steps (B=8pi x 10^-2 T, εmax=NcBA) match and are kept verbatim.

questions.reason: Circuit diagram for the Ge/Si diode network (page 10) is not reproduced; can't verify the original V0 configuration before the Ge diode is reversed without it.
Circuit diagram (Si and Ge diodes, 12V source, 5.6 kOhm resistor) not reproduced; only isolated labels are extractable, not the topology.
questions.notes: MS's intermediate step '12.07 - 0.3 = 11V' is a garbled rendering of '12 - 0.7 - 0.3' in the source itself; kept verbatim correctly, final answer (D) 11V/1.96mA is unambiguous.

questions.reason: Circuit diagram (two diodes with 50 ohm forward resistance each, 100 ohm resistor, 6V battery) not reproduced; can't verify the topology without it.
questions.notes: MS's derivation text is a garbled stacked fraction in the source itself; final value (0.02A, option B) is clear and kept verbatim.

questions.reason: No circuit diagram or values are given in the question text itself (points A and B refer to an un-reproduced figure); not answerable from text alone.
questions.notes: MS's derivation text is garbled in the source itself; final value (10V, option C) and the forward-bias reasoning are clear and kept verbatim.
Apparatus is described in the case-study stem; the numeric answer follows entirely from the given work function and frequency, no diagram needed.

questions.reason: Apparatus diagram showing terminal B's position/role is not reproduced; can't verify how shifting it left affects the reading without it.
Answer is a graph (reading vs terminal-B position) not reproduced, and the apparatus diagram needed to attempt it is also missing.

questions.notes: Parts (A) and (B) match the MS in full (C=Aeps0/d derivation, capacitance-of-sphere-in-water reasoning); part (C) is a V-vs-d graph with no text answer in either the pack or the MS.

questions.reason: Figure showing points A, B, C, D (question explicitly says 'use fig for reference') is not reproduced; can't verify the path comparison in part (B) without it.
questions.notes: MS explains part (B) via 'electric field is conservative in nature' although the question states a uniform external magnetic field; this inconsistency is present in the source itself and is correctly reproduced verbatim by the pack.

Sub-part grouping (lens-maker derivation + equi-convex radius calc, 3+2 marks, under heading '32.(I)') confirmed directly against the MS, which groups them the same way despite the SQP's own two-column layout interleaving the two OR alternatives. MS itself calls the lens 'convexo-concave' in part (B) though the question asks about an 'Equi-convex' lens; reproduced verbatim as a source inconsistency.
Sub-part grouping (angle-of-deviation definition + prism relation + minimum-deviation condition, 1+3+1 marks, under heading '32(II)') confirmed directly against the MS.

MS literally prints 'Iron ore is placed inside the coil' (an evident source typo for 'core'); the pack's officialAnswer silently prints 'Iron core' instead of reproducing 'ore' verbatim. Harmless (obviously correct physics term) but technically not a verbatim quote. MS also mentions 'Rv...parallel' in part (C) though only an ammeter (Ra) conversion was asked in (B); that inconsistency is in the source and is reproduced verbatim.
All circuit values (R, Xc, Xl, turns ratio, Vin) are given in the text; the referenced figure is not needed to solve it.
